subject.title: feat(ui): expand the lobster pet's random universe

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this full expanded lobster-pet universe—including new persistent Lobsterdex state, animations, and seasonal/decorative behavior—as a supported long-term Control UI feature?
rationale: The implementation is substantial user-facing product scope rather than a repair, and the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision on whether this level of decorative surface and maintenance commitment belongs in the product.

options.title: Sponsor the expanded pet experience
options.body: Confirm the decorative scope is intentional, then rebase or refresh the branch and proceed through ordinary merge review.

options.title: Narrow the feature set
options.body: Keep a selected subset of the new variants or persistence behavior and request a reduced follow-up diff before merge.

options.title: Defer decorative expansion
options.body: Pause the PR if the Control UI should remain limited to the existing lightweight pet behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the expanded pet experience
recommendation.body: Confirm the decorative scope is intentional, then rebase or refresh the branch and proceed through ordinary merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows this contributor carrying the complete implementation and follow-up lifecycle repairs; a maintainer must still make the product decision.
